notes.title: Update 3.5
notes.content:
Hi all,

I'm happy to announce the opening of the Steam workshop for Lands of Sorcery!
Currently the only mods you can do is custom loading screens. Not the most exciting thing, but we have to start somewhere. In the future, support for more things should come: battle and camping backgrounds is a priority, and characters are also important of course. 

Mods are created and uploaded from the game app itself. Here's the guide on how to do it.

Steam Guide: How to create Loading Screen mods

Give it a go, don't be afraid to publish, you can always delete your mod if things go wrong 😅

Cheers!
Rubmon

notes.title: Update 3.3
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update addresses some things posted in the forums such as the trinkets bug and alternative color scheme for morale/health, plus a little feature that allows you to play your own music during battle and map scenes.

To have your own music files playing, place them inside the 'Battle' and 'Map' folders located in:
\steamapps\common\Lands of Sorcery\Lands of Sorcery_Data\StreamingAssets\Music

Supported formats are MP3, Ogg and Wav.

Enjoy!
Rubmon

notes.title: Barbarian Supporter Pack DLC out now
notes.content:
Hello!

The first DLC for Lands of Sorcery has landed! It contains several goodies for you to enjoy outside of the game.

Soundtrack
Over 20 mins of auditory joy with music from the game. Not all songs are present due to licensing restrictions, but the awesome Manowar-like main track is there, full quality WAV and MP3 included.

Storyboard Panels
Collection of 20 storyboard panels that were used as the base for the pencil drawing panels used in the Gloomy Whisper campaign cut scenes.
17 in UHD 4k, 3 in QHD 1440p

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38308582/f0921cba9742996c0ed9bc6ea625bc1fbf4286fc.png

Wallpapers
5 wallpapers without any text or logo. Just beautiful backdrops from the game, available in 16:9 and 16:10 ratios, from FullHD to UltraHD resolutions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38308582/ac41bf48b94f95970ebf97388b6e8b9bad21fb56.png

Get your pack now and help fund further developments for LoS or upcoming productions from Sun Bay Games!

notes.title: Update 2.0 - New campaign
notes.content:
Hi all!

The time has come to transition Lands of Sorcery out of Early Access. Today's update adds the new campaign and with the characters and balancing work done during the past year, I think the initial goals for the project have been met. What this means is that probably no new content will be added to the game at this point and development will now be focused on fixing bugs and improving balancing according to feedback.

The scope of a game in this genre is really massive for a solo developer and wouldn't be possible without the help from some awesome (and affordable!) freelancers and great stock assets.

I'd like to thank every one of you who supported this project so far. Please comment in the forums with any ideas or bugs you find. Have fun!

Cheers!
Rubmon

notes.title: Update 1.20
notes.content:
Greetings!

New update, focusing on:

 Balancing. The main campaign is now shorter as some complained about grinding. Never an easy thing to fix with limited dev resources, but I'm hoping the new campaign and sub-quests will bring more content variety. 
 Intimidation Revamp. The battle hud now shows Morale bars alongside Health. This should make the effects/importance of the Intimidation/Morale system more obvious. Also created new achievements for Morale outcomes (Panic and Flee on the enemy, and getting the Bravery effect on one of your characters).
 New enemy: the Fat Ogre, which will appear in the desert.

Enjoy,
Rubmon

notes.title: Dev Update 4 - Almost there...
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38308582/38038c5cfe5be58aa94ea9c4edd166f9256ae309.png

Hello friends!

The wait is almost over - Lands of Sorcery is currently undergoing beta testing and I'm hoping to release it in the coming weeks. Initial release will be via a discounted soft launch over at itch.io, as I hope to gather good feedback and fix major issues before releasing on steam, which should happen not long after.

Make sure to follow the project there if you want to be among the first to play. Of course, any purchase at itch.io willl get a steam key when available.

Thanks to all who have wishlisted and are following the game! ːsteamhappyː

All the best,
Rubmon

notes.title: Development Update 3
notes.content:
Greetings!

Just finished a pre-alpha version of the game, meaning it can be played from beginning to end through the Gloomy Whisper campaign. 

Major thing added was a HUB 2.0, this part of the design was too basic and has now been revamped to include upgradable characters that travel with you but won't do battle. These are things like a thief who'll sell trinkets and provisions to you, or a harlot which will raise the team's...morale ːsteamhappyː
Including a pic of the Trainer here.

There's no balancing whatsoever, so that's the next focus, as well as adding juicy battle sounds and special FX.

Still haven't decided on the release plan, but will most likely start with a sort of soft-launch on itch.io. Copies bought there will come with a Steam key.

Cheers,
Rubmon

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38308582/5741841c3480ae0916ec1b3117a1c6065899b386.png

notes.title: Development Update 2
notes.content:
Greetings!

Here's a new update, probably the last this year!

 Cut scenes for the Gloomy Whisper campaign are finished! Now, there's no AAA cinematics here, but I'm really happy with the result, had lots of fun doing it with the animator and voice over freelancers, and I hope you'll get the fun and goofy vibe of the whole thing.
 In the UI front, work is well under way and this will be the focus for the next weeks. 

After that, most work should on the gameplay itself and the skirmish campaign.

See you in the next update!
Rubmon
